skill-tree-add-pending-task.title: Skill-Tree: Add Pending Task
skill-tree-add-pending-task.description: Capture an informal request as brief understood Pending work with an ID and numeric priority. Use for Add pending; clarify material missing intent before insertion.

sections.text:
Read applicable repository rules, the manifest and relevant current documentation. Read [intake](references/pending-task-intake.md), [format](references/pending-task-format.md) and [metadata](references/workflow-metadata.md). Confirm subject/change/outcome and duplicates before insertion. Ask contextual questions when required intent is missing. Use scripts/workflow-state.py intake with the inspected source hash. Return Pending ID, title, priority and deferred details. Intake never promotes or implements work.

Generated prose follows [document rules](references/document-rules.md). No unrelated changes, implicit permission or source/sibling dependency.

skill-tree-create-documents-snapshot.title: Skill-Tree: Create Snapshot
skill-tree-create-documents-snapshot.description: Create an explicitly requested Markdown documentation snapshot archive without editing live documents.

sections.text:
Read repository rules and [snapshot scope](references/snapshot-rules.md). Inspect candidate relevance, then run scripts/create-documentation-snapshot.py <repository> --dry-run with requested --include, --member-style and --output/--output-dir options. Create the requested archive only after scope is understood. Preserve live sources, exclude private/generated/vendor content and verify member names/notices. Return archive path and scope; commit only under explicit authorization.

Generated prose follows [document rules](references/document-rules.md). No unrelated changes, implicit permission or source/sibling dependency.

skill-tree-implement-all.title: Skill-Tree: Implement All
skill-tree-implement-all.description: Implement an initial prioritized snapshot and required dependencies with resumable checkpoints; defer new nonblocking work.

sections.text:
Read applicable rules, [orchestration](references/orchestration.md) and [metadata](references/workflow-metadata.md). Query the index/checkpoint first. Start mode all only when no active run exists; otherwise resume. Use scripts/workflow-state.py advance before handoffs. After scoped processing, automatically choose the recommended eligible unit inside the recorded root/snapshot boundary; routine next-action questions apply only to standalone processing. Material questions and execution stops remain binding. Follow bundled [intake](references/pending-task-intake.md) and [processing/implementation](references/future-workflow.md) contracts. Query compact history only when relevant. Return completed/deferred/blocked IDs, checks and next action. No scheduler or blanket execution permission is implied.

skill-tree-implement-next-future-task.title: Skill-Tree: Implement Next Task
skill-tree-implement-next-future-task.description: Implement the highest-priority Prioritized task or an exact task ID/name; capture findings and record acceptance evidence before completion.

sections.text:
Read repository rules, [workflow](references/future-workflow.md), [metadata](references/workflow-metadata.md), selected task questions, current documentation and task-relevant source/tests. Use scripts/workflow-state.py select: highest priority wins, ties follow document order; exact IDs/names never fall back. A blocked selection stops. Implement minimal scoped changes and capture findings through intake with root/direct-parent context. Perform authorized validation and review, update current documentation, then complete with individual acceptance/source evidence. Required unrun checks prevent completion. Record authorized commits only after commit creation. Return completed/needs-dependencies/needs-clarification/validation-blocked outcome and captured IDs. Never implement from the queue alone.

Generated prose follows [document rules](references/document-rules.md). No unrelated changes, implicit permission or source/sibling dependency. Read [development practices](references/development-practices.md) for test-oracle and behavior-preservation decisions.

skill-tree-process-future-pending.title: Skill-Tree: Process Pending Tasks
skill-tree-process-future-pending.description: Research Pending tasks selected by IDs or exact names and produce Ready prioritized tasks with provenance. No selection processes the Pending Queue.

sections.text:
Read applicable rules, current documentation, relevant implementation/configuration/tests and [workflow](references/future-workflow.md). Use scripts/workflow-state.py pending to resolve the complete selection before research. Read [metadata](references/workflow-metadata.md) for process payloads. Split oversized work, preserve Pending parent IDs, clarify required decisions and retain blocked intake. Apply researched dispositions through process with the inspected source hash. Return created/reused/retained/resolved IDs and the refreshed prioritized list with brief outcomes/blockers. Follow the workflow processing-result contract: standalone invocation presents next choices, places one recommended action last and waits for the developer; explicit Work Through Next/Implement All invocation returns to the bounded controller for automatic eligible selection. An active checkpoint alone implies no continuation.

Generated prose follows [document rules](references/document-rules.md). No unrelated changes, implicit permission or source/sibling dependency.

skill-tree-repo-documentation.title: Skill-Tree: Initialize Documents
skill-tree-repo-documentation.description: Initialize or repair current repository documentation, the Skill Tree navigation manifest and task index from source evidence.

sections.text:
Read applicable repository rules and [output contract](references/documentation-output-contract.md). Inspect source using [discovery](references/repository-discovery-checklist.md). Create the required current document set; preserve unowned instructions. Read [metadata](references/workflow-metadata.md); initialize future.md explicitly, then refresh index and manifest. Capture confirmed documentation findings in Backlog with stable IDs and evidence. Review document rules and validators; report verified facts, unknowns and actual checks.

Generated prose follows [document rules](references/document-rules.md). No unrelated changes, implicit permission or source/sibling dependency. After queue setup, run scripts/workflow-state.py capture-foundation against the covered root; report the captured or reused Pending ID before implementation selection.

skill-tree-repo-documentation-audit.title: Skill-Tree: Audit Documents
skill-tree-repo-documentation-audit.description: Audit current repository documentation against implementation and persist bounded findings, coverage and source fingerprints.

sections.text:
Read rules, manifest, current documents and [output contract](references/documentation-output-contract.md). Inspect relevant source/configuration/tests using [discovery](references/repository-discovery-checklist.md); document-to-document comparison alone is insufficient. Repair drift and missing required documents from current evidence. Capture confirmed issues in Backlog with IDs and evidence. Read [metadata](references/workflow-metadata.md) and [retention](references/history-retention.md); persist an audit with stable finding IDs, source coverage and unrun checks. Refresh manifest; run scripts/validate-repository-documentation.py and scoped scripts/validate-document-rules.py diagnostics; report corrections, unresolved findings and actual validation. No product implementation is implied.

Generated prose follows [document rules](references/document-rules.md). No unrelated changes, implicit permission or source/sibling dependency.
